questions.prompt: You searched for a company in Kube and it doesn't appear under Company, Member, or Lead. What do you do first?
choices: Create the contract without a company
questions.explanation: Kube contracts → Step 1: check Include Archived before adding a new user.

questions.prompt: Which field controls the proration of the first month's rent and when booking credits activate?
questions.explanation: Kube contracts → Step 2: the Move-in Date drives both.

questions.prompt: Which settings are correct on the Terms & Company page? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Kube contracts → Step 2 table. Auto Renew must be On.

questions.prompt: If “Bill Full Contract Cost at Start of Term” was enabled by mistake on an active contract, you can turn it off with an amendment.
questions.explanation: Kube contracts → Warning: it cannot be disabled by amendment; the contract must be terminated and recreated.

questions.prompt: After you click Save & Continue, changes on the following pages are saved automatically.
questions.explanation: Kube contracts → Note under Save & Continue.

questions.prompt: You go back and change the Move-in Date on the Terms & Company page after the contract was first saved. What must you do?
questions.explanation: Step 2 note: changes on Terms & Company need Save & Continue to apply.

questions.prompt: For a contract at the Seattle property you should add the “4 Conference Room Hours/Month” booking credit.
questions.explanation: Step 4: Seattle has no booking credits — skip that step.

questions.prompt: Which method of communication can be used to activate a contract right now?
choices: Neither — activation is done by Yardi
questions.explanation: Step 6: Manual Method of Communication ONLY for now.

questions.prompt: On the Activate screen no charges are listed. What does that mean?
choices: The Move-in Date is after the next Monthly Posting date; Kube adds the charges then
The member has no payment method
questions.explanation: Step 6, note under the checkbox step.

questions.prompt: What does the Due Date on the Activate screen control?
choices: When the first automatic payment attempt is made (if auto-pay is on)

questions.prompt: Which are steps of the Manual signing method? (Select all that apply)
choices: Upload the hand-signed agreement via Signed Document Upload
Click Send to start the ySign timeline
Click Email to send the agreement to the member
Click Activate in the upper-right corner
questions.explanation: Step 5 → Manual. “Send” belongs to the ySign path.
